name: CPU Backend
description: CPUBackend, the CPU RenderBackend and pixel reference (Sources/CoreRender/CPU), supporting every op family: its surfaces are PixelBuffers held in the shared SurfaceStore; surface, read and release go through the SurfaceStore; display and in-place composite (every blend mode, gated by its family) are the CoreRaster calls themselves, and crop, rotate, resample, blur, unsharp, each tone adjustment and masked clone (CPUBackend+Ops) each call the CoreRaster method they name and return a new surface. CoreRaster errors map to RenderError.raster with the same message.
